description: This file defines a set of converter classes for transforming between JSON objects and Java collections (List and Map) within the Apache OFBiz framework. It implements a ConverterLoader interface to load these converters and provides specific classes for converting JSON to List, JSON to Map, List to JSON, and Map to JSON.

classes.name: JSONConverters
classes.description: Main class that loads converter definitions and contains nested converter classes for JSON/List and JSON/Map transformations.

classes.name: JSONToList
classes.description: Converts a JSON object to a List of Objects.

classes.name: JSONToMap
classes.description: Converts a JSON object to a Map with String keys and Object values.

classes.name: ListToJSON
classes.description: Converts a List of Objects to a JSON object.

classes.name: MapToJSON
classes.description: Converts a Map with String keys and Object values to a JSON object.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Performs conversion between JSON and Java collections. Overloaded for different source/target types.

methods.name: loadConverters
methods.description: Loads contained JSON converter classes into the framework.
